title: Showmob mechanics: from JSON to a live page
summary: The short map of how a Showmob page goes from a JSON file to the live site.

blocks.title: From a JSON file to the live site
blocks.body: A Showmob page starts as a JSON artifact. The renderer turns its blocks into UI, the build packages the app, GitHub holds review, and Vercel serves the accepted commit. Later lessons walk each step; this page is the map.

nodes.title: Artifact
nodes.detail: A JSON file describes the page and its ordered blocks.

nodes.title: Renderer
nodes.detail: React reads each block type and selects a trusted widget.

nodes.title: Build
nodes.detail: TypeScript checks the code and Vite bundles browser-ready assets.

nodes.title: Review
nodes.detail: A branch and pull request keep the change inspectable before main changes.

nodes.title: Deploy
nodes.detail: Vercel builds branch previews, then production after a merge to main.

blocks.heading: 2. Words used on this line
rows: Holds title, status, theme and blocks.
Defines the shapes the renderer accepts.
Turns a known block shape into visible UI.
Changes approved visual tokens without changing content.
Checks code, then emits production files.
Put the accepted job in service
Makes one tested commit available at a URL.
blocks.caption: Shop analogies are optional memory aids. Prefer the web terms when editing the repo.

blocks.heading: 3. A fast tour before the details

slides.title: Content is data
slides.body: Most new Showmob pages are JSON, not custom React components.

slides.title: The renderer owns behavior
slides.body: A block says what it is. App.tsx decides how that type looks and behaves.

slides.title: A merge is a release event
slides.body: In this connected repository, merging a reviewed PR to main triggers a production deployment.

blocks.heading: 4. Check the line
blocks.prompt: Which item should usually change when adding a normal lesson page?
options: A JSON artifact registered in the content library
blocks.explanation: Showmob separates content from renderer code. A normal lesson is structured data using existing blocks.
